review.notes: First-person testimony in simple language. The perfective with ने (मैंने ... माँगी; उसने कहा कि ...) and कि-clauses; habitual past (करते थे, पढ़ता था). Christian words as Hindi churches say them (परमेश्वर, यीशु, क्षमा, शांति, कलीसिया). परमेश्वर and यीशु are read as names by the adapter and count as known. "मेरी गवाही" is the plan's word for testimony; a Hindi Christian reviewer should confirm that गवाही is the natural everyday word. The last third brings back the Diwali, kitchen and message words as the story of the first year in this city. Sam's personal history here (a quiet home, work, money, an empty heart) is invented for the course and must be checked by the owner. Words outside the plan (measured, adapter lemmas x tokens): कपड़ा×2 (under-met).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.english: This is my testimony.
I am Sam.

sentences.text: जब मैं छोटा था, मेरा घर अच्छा था।
sentences.english: When I was small, my home was good.

sentences.text: मेरी माँ और मेरे पापा मुझसे प्यार करते थे।
sentences.english: My mother and my father loved me.

sentences.text: मेरा भाई और मेरी बहन भी अच्छे थे।
sentences.english: My brother and my sister were good too.

sentences.text: लेकिन जब मैं बड़ा हुआ, मेरा दिल उदास था।
sentences.english: But when I grew up, my heart was sad.
I worked a lot.

sentences.text: मुझे नौकरी मिली, और मेरे पास पैसा भी था।
sentences.english: I got a job, and I had money too.
I wore good clothes.

sentences.text: लेकिन मेरे दिल में शांति नहीं थी।
sentences.english: But there was no peace in my heart.
I looked for peace in the world.
I wept.
I wept a lot.

sentences.text: मेरे जीवन में प्रेम नहीं था।
sentences.english: There was no love in my life.
I needed love.

sentences.text: मेरे पाप बहुत थे, और मैं यह समझता था।
sentences.english: My sins were many, and I knew it.

sentences.text: एक दिन एक अजनबी मेरे पास आया।
sentences.english: One day a stranger came to me.
He took my hand.

sentences.text: उसने कहा कि परमेश्वर तुमसे प्रेम करता है।
sentences.english: He said that God loves you.
I did not accept his words.
I asked, "Where is God?"

sentences.text: अजनबी ने मुझे एक बाइबल दी।
sentences.english: The stranger gave me a Bible.
I read the Bible.

sentences.text: मैंने पढ़ा कि परमेश्वर ने दुनिया से प्रेम किया।
sentences.english: I read that God loved the world.
I accepted this.
I took his hand too.
I understood my sin.

sentences.text: अगर आप चाहें, तो आप भी बाइबल पढ़िए।
sentences.english: If you want, you too, read the Bible.

sentences.text: तब मैंने परमेश्वर से क्षमा माँगी।
sentences.english: Then I asked God for forgiveness.

sentences.text: मैंने और भी बहुत कुछ माँगा।
sentences.english: I asked for much more as well.
Jesus saved me.
My sin was forgiven.
Peace came into my heart.
My life became new.
Now I am not sad.
God gave me love.

sentences.text: मैंने नए कपड़े पहने, और मैं हँसा।
sentences.english: I put on new clothes, and I laughed.

sentences.text: मैं पास्टर अनिल की कलीसिया में गया।
sentences.english: I went to Pastor Anil's church.
The people of the church are good.

sentences.text: मैं हर रविवार कलीसिया जाता हूँ।
sentences.english: I go to the church every Sunday.
There I am not a stranger.
God forgives everyone.
He saves the world.
He saves you too.
You too, ask, and believe.

sentences.text: मैं अपनी गवाही सबको देता हूँ।
sentences.english: I give my testimony to everyone.

sentences.text: मैं इस शहर में अपनी गवाही के लिए आया।
sentences.english: I came to this city to give my testimony.
This is my new life.

sentences.text: इस साल मैं नानी के घर में मेहमान हूँ।
sentences.english: This year I am a guest at Nani's house.
Nani is very kind.
Aman is my friend.

sentences.text: रवि सर मुझे हिंदी पढ़ाते हैं।
sentences.english: Ravi sir teaches me Hindi.

sentences.text: मैं रोज़ बाज़ार जाता हूँ, और लोगों से बात करता हूँ।
sentences.english: I go to the market every day and talk with people.
I am very happy here.

sentences.text: नानी पालक धोती हैं और काटती हैं।
sentences.english: Nani washes and cuts the spinach.

sentences.text: वह बर्तन चूल्हे पर रखती हैं।
sentences.english: She puts the pot on the stove.

sentences.text: वह तेल, हल्दी, नमक और मसाला डालती हैं।
sentences.english: She adds oil, turmeric, salt and spice.
I check with a spoon.

sentences.text: नानी पानी उबालती हैं और दाल पकाती हैं।
sentences.english: Nani boils water and cooks the dal.
Nani says, "Don't run."

sentences.text: दिवाली में पड़ोसी घर सजाते हैं।
sentences.english: At Diwali the neighbours decorate their houses.

sentences.text: गली में रोशनी है, और दीया भी।
sentences.english: There is light in the lane, and lamps too.
I wished them well for the festival.
They gave me sweets.

sentences.text: मैंने उपहार में एक तकिया दिया।
sentences.english: I gave a pillow as a gift.

sentences.text: एक बच्चा उदास था, और अमन उसका साथी है।
sentences.english: A child was sad, and Aman is his friend.
Pastor Anil sent a message.
There was a notice of the meeting in it.
I gave a reply.
It was good news.
At the meeting the children shout.
I made the call.

sentences.text: परमेश्वर ने मेरी नौकरी और मेरा साल अच्छा किया।
sentences.english: God made my job and my year good.
